t: This is Petticoat Lane Market, a fashion and clothing market in Spitalfields. It's really two neighbouring street markets. Wentworth Street Market is open six days a week, and Middlesex Street Market opens on Sundays only. The boxer Dutch Sam was born here in 1775. Samuel Elias, as he was properly called, fought between 1801 and 1814 and was known as the hardest hitter of his era. His nickname was The Man with the Iron Hand.
